16.title: A patch evaluated against a private input
16.body: A language model agent fixed the demo bug, committed and revealed with a key limited to those two calls, and was paid when the contract accepted the proof.
16.note: Bounty 16 used the public demo module, so anyone can check its input. It shows the path, not a model's skill.
16.shows: a limited key can commit and reveal, a proof can be checked on chain, and the reward follows.
16.not_shown: skill on a private bug, production security or an external audit.

24.title: A private bug fixed without seeing it
24.body: A language model agent on NEAR AI Cloud read only the public code of a new module, found its division by zero, and committed and revealed a fix with a key limited to those two calls. On a rented GPU the vendor proved and shrank the fix in under a minute (51.5 s); with the Groth16 wrap on a separate machine (337.73 s) the whole proof took about 6.5 minutes of work, and this run, done by hand, reached the contract 6 h 10 min after the reveal. The contract paid when it accepted the proof.
24.note: Bounty 24 is a private bounty: its secret input and reference fix never left the vendor, and the bug is not named in the public source. The proof took 29.82 s to prove and 21.71 s to shrink on one rented GPU, then 337.73 s to wrap to Groth16 on a separate machine; by hand, from reveal to the accepted proof, 6 h 10 min.
24.shows: an agent fixed a private bug from public code alone, a limited key committed and revealed, and the contract checked the proof itself and paid.
24.not_shown: skill on harder bugs (this is a one line fix), production security or an external audit.

17.lead: A language model agent fixed a bug it could not see. The vendor's proof did not finish inside the 4 hour window, so the contract paid by timeout.
why: The agent's module equals the private reference fix byte for byte. That was checked natively and is recorded (docs/evidence/agent/native_check_bounty17_attempt0.txt).
The vendor's laptop proof finished after the window. The contract refuses a late proof.
The evidence proof was not submitted
A proof run later says PASS. It is evidence on file, not a settlement.
measured: Then succinct 1,496.74 s and Groth16 177.04 s
17.measured_note: Two earlier proof tries were stopped by the project's memory guard when other work used memory. The third finished after the window. Source: docs/numbers.md.
claims: The agent's fix equals the private reference fix
A full proof of the attempt says PASS
The model could not see the reference fix
Search of the repository history and the prompt contents
The contract verified a proof for this attempt
It did not. Paid by timeout.
17.caveat: A one line fix is often the reference fix byte for byte, so a secret reference fix protects little once someone solves it. The agent also ran on the same laptop as the vendor's files. Its code never read the private folder, but nothing technical stopped a process of that user from doing so.
